observations: High handle/private-memory processes are renderer processes, not GPU-process roles.
Renderer growth in two native type snapshots is entirely accounted for by Section handles; other type counts are unchanged.
Baseline cadence of about one handle per 1.4 seconds aligns with shared ack polling, but cadence alone is not causal proof.
Independent synthetic response-body A/B retained exactly 600 extra Sections for 600 unconsumed responses.
limitations: Partial baseline only; no two-hour completion or zero-leak claim.
Native type snapshots have no public object names, paths, kernel addresses or raw command lines.
Synthetic Chrome and installed WebView2 builds differ; installed fix validation remains required.
Private-memory growth can have other components; Section-handle result does not explain every byte.
Installed app and settings were not changed, stopped or restarted during this investigation.
